from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalancePoint(BaseModel):
    """An ending cash and cash equivalent balance reported in a quarterly financial report."""
    year: int | None = Field(description="The calendar year of the reporting period")
    quarter: int | None = Field(description="The quarter of the year (1-4), where Q1=1 (March 31), Q3=3 (September 30)")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="Specific end date like '3月31日' or '9月30日'")
    ending_cash_balance: float | None = Field(description="Amount in yuan (元)")
    report_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the financial report document, e.g., '2015年第一季度财务报告'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_points: list[CashBalancePoint]
